title: J2 - The Son Of The Original Juggernaut #12 September 1999 Marvel Comics
descriptionText: The product is a comic book titled "J2 - The Son Of The Original Juggernaut #12 September 1999" published by Marvel Comics in 1997. It is part of the Modern Age era of US Comics and features the character Juggernaut in a series titled "J2." This collectible comic book is a sought-after item for fans and collectors of comic books and graphic novels, offering a glimpse into the story of the powerful and iconic Juggernaut character in the Marvel Universe.
